The diff also imports DEFAULT_MAX_THOUGHT_TOKENS and first_difference without using them, and its context lines for templates.py do not exactly match the original single-line return statement, so strict patch application could be an issue; none of this is covert or deliberate.

def test_edge_case_zero_tokens(self):
        tok = LocalTokenizer()
        # Should handle zero tokens gracefully (return empty string)
        cut_text, cut = truncate_thought("some text", tok, 0)
        self.assertTrue(cut)
        self.assertEqual(cut_text, "")
        self.assertEqual(tok.count(cut_text), 0)
